prompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished raster concept sheet for an established Legend of the Five Rings Emperor Edition tabletop game UI. Concept A: CONTINUOUS BRASS RAIL. Reference image is aesthetic reference only: preserve its realistic worn black lacquer, thin antique gold frame, inset circular medallions and softly illuminated horizontal brass track. Replace the four-part bar with SIX equally readable segments labeled EXACTLY left to right STRAIGHTEN, EVENTS, ACTION, ATTACK, DYNASTY, END. Do not retain EMPEROR or BATTLE as phase names. Wide landscape concept sheet on dark navy woven gaming mat, warm tavern candlelight. Main large close-up six-part rail fills width near top. ATTACK is active with soft champagne-gold illumination diffusing along its segment, no harsh rectangular highlight. Labels in restrained Japanese brush heading lettering, legible pale parchment. Underneath show one smaller full-width context strip mounted at the top of a minimal game viewport silhouette to demonstrate practical sizing, and a small elegant hover help plaque for EVENTS reading 'Events' and 'Resolve Events-phase effects.' Lower margin label 'A · CONTINUOUS BRASS RAIL' and 'Concept · six phases · illustrative state'. No cards, no extra game zones, no invented rules. Physically rendered materials and convincing beveled metal, NOT flat vector dashboard. Ornamentation small and no large wasted vertical space. All six labels remain visible and easy to read. Do not imply phases are clickable skip controls.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished raster concept sheet for Legend of the Five Rings Emperor Edition game interface. Concept B: SIX CEREMONIAL SEALS. Use reference only for weathered black lacquer and subtle antique gold rail aesthetic. Design ONE horizontal low-profile phase bar across the top of navy woven mat. Six small engraved bronze seals linked by a thin inset gold path. Above each seal label EXACTLY in order STRAIGHTEN, EVENTS, ACTION, ATTACK, DYNASTY, END. Gentle brush-style parchment headings. Distinct subtle engraved motifs: rising leaf for Straighten, scroll for Events, open hand for Action, daisho crossed Japanese swords for Attack, palace for Dynasty, setting sun for End. All labels always present; icon is supplemental. EVENTS seal softly lit warm gold with gentle halo and its label brightened; others subdued but readable. No oversized coins, all six fit same width as original top HUD. Photoreal aged metals, sculpted lacquer frame, small fine corner accents. Sheet includes large close-up main bar and below a small inset showing STRAIGHTEN highlighted with a compact help plaque 'Straighten' / 'Resolve straightening and any required choices.' That help describes phase only, not tactical advice. Bottom title 'B · SIX CEREMONIAL SEALS' with 'Concept · illustrative states'. No cards, no futuristic vector UI, no unrelated game screens. Design should be asset-feasible with fixed six markers and live highlights, luxurious yet sparse.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a premium realistic concept sheet for Legend of the Five Rings Emperor Edition UI. Concept C: COMPACT RAIL + CONTEXT. A worn black lacquer horizontal bar, antique brass edge, shallow six medallions and six subtle connected segments, aesthetically close to reference. Label all six EXACTLY STRAIGHTEN, EVENTS, ACTION, ATTACK, DYNASTY, END, with understated legible Japanese brush headings in pale parchment. ACTION active with soft warm gold halo and gentle diffuse segment light. Main composition shows broad desktop version at top, then narrower window version below with ALL six names and markers still present, proportionally smaller ornament and tighter gaps rather than omitted phases. Directly beneath narrower bar show a small centered parchment-black help popover anchored to ACTION, with heading 'Action' and body 'Resolve legal actions for this phase.' A tiny '?' affordance opens help; phase markers are informational and must not look like buttons to skip turns. Clear callout 'Help on hover or focus' in modest serif lettering. Deep navy mat backdrop with restrained warm lantern falloff, true textured bitmap material, aged metal bevels, no vector/dashboard look. Bottom title 'C · COMPACT RAIL + CONTEXT' and 'Concept · wide and compact layouts'. No cards or broad board redesign. No automatic-phase timing or rules changes depicted. Make the wider and compact bars clearly both show six distinct phases. Avoid huge vertical HUD.
revisionC: Edit only the attached concept C sheet. Remove the large Japanese characters above all six English phase names in BOTH bars and the character at the left of the help popover. Keep all six English phase labels exactly STRAIGHTEN, EVENTS, ACTION, ATTACK, DYNASTY, END, make those English phase labels restrained pale parchment brush lettering matching a Musashi-style heading font. Reduce the bars' height into the space freed by removing the characters. Preserve the aged lacquer/brass artwork, active ACTION glow, both desktop and compact demonstrations, help popover text, navy mat/tavern palette and bottom C label. Remove extra decorative slogan text from the top right and bottom corners. No new symbols or writing. This should be a clean compact English interface concept consistent with the reference game.
